cohort: The study included 3850 women who had a vaginal birth at a single tertiary care unit between February 1, 2022, and December 31, 2023.
finding: Intravenous administration of 5 IU or 10 IU oxytocin is more effective than intramuscular administration of 10 IU in reducing the incidence of PPH after vaginal deliveries, with similar efficacy observed between the two IV regimens.
